title: Fixed Cumulative State
summary: Precompute cumulative information once so a fixed range can be answered from two boundary states.
recognition_signals: many queries ask about a fixed prefix or range
the answer can be combined from two precomputed boundary states
the underlying data does not change between queries
core_rules: The range answer is the combination of the state before the range and the state after it.
structural_steps: combine the two boundary states for each query

common_confusions.distinction: A moving window maintains one active range as its boundaries change. Prefix state precomputes cumulative information for fixed-range queries.
